description:
Create a new table named 'Person' in the Chinook database and populate it with a unified list of all people (Customers and Employees). 

1. Create the 'Person' table with these columns: 
   - FirstName (Text/VARCHAR)
   - LastName (Text/VARCHAR)
   - Email (Text/VARCHAR)
   - Role (Text/VARCHAR)

2. Insert all records from the 'Customer' table into 'Person', setting the 'Role' column to the text 'Customer'.
3. Insert all records from the 'Employee' table into 'Person', setting the 'Role' column to the text 'Employee'.

4. Save the table and database (Ctrl+S). 

The final 'Person' table should contain exactly 67 rows (59 Customers + 8 Employees).
